entry: docs/PREREGISTRATION.md D-16 (PATHWAYS §0.6 item 7, G §4, Gate N1)
status: drafted 2026-10-01 at the owner's request, before any Gate N1 run; may be changed in place, with a written reason, until the first Gate N1 pilot run, and never after it
candidate_levels: the reference level to L-2, and L-1 only when the last level holds at least last_level_near_target of its target on the mean of the cell's runs, L the deepest populated level of the pilot's settled tree at n_w (G §4 scope decision; 19 derives them when --levels is omitted)

margin_units.fill_sampled: fill B_i/C_i; at least the file granularity F_sst/C_2 = 1/64 at T=2, base 16 MiB
margin_units.released: bytes released per turnover, in units of C_i
margin_units.passthrough_overlap: bytes written per byte released; 0.1 x (1 + T), a tenth of the nominal rho + o = 1 + T
margin_units.rho_tilde: share of released bytes that land below
margin_units.inflow_ratio: a turnover's inflow rate over the run's mean

n_min_rule.note: grid values above half the reference's pooled turnovers are not tried

pilot.arm: native at the pipeline default point: K0 4, base 16 MiB, m = 1
